text: 兆易创新：截至2026年8月31日，公司通过集中竞价交易方式累计回购股份166.23万股，占公司总股本的比例为0.24%，已支付的总金额为人民币6.54亿元
text_en: GigaDevice: As of August 31, 2026, company cumulatively repurchased 1.6623 million shares via centralized competitive trading, representing 0.24% of total share capital, with total payment of RMB 654 million
